data.plain_english: Hong Kong shares fell sharply, and the council thinks technology companies, banks and property firms are likely to keep doing worse for now. People are worried that excitement around artificial intelligence has gone too far, though the fall may also be tied to US borrowing costs and a holiday that closed mainland China's markets. Hong Kong tech shares had already dropped a lot over the past year, so some members think much of the bad news is already reflected in prices. The council is most divided on energy companies, where it has little confidence either way because they fell less than the others. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell anything.
